query_name: Question 1 Eligible partners by service area and time frame: SELECT organizations, organization_services, services, service_areas, service_priority_support, priority_levels
source_file: database/queries.sql:20 (Question 1 Eligible partners by service area and time frame)
sql_statement_or_sqlalchemy_equivalent:
SELECT
    o.organization_id,
    o.name AS organization_name,
    s.name AS service_name,
    sa.region_name AS service_area,
    pl.level_name AS supported_priority,
    pl.deadline_hours,
    os.status AS service_offering_status,
    os.active_referral_limit,
    os.current_active_referrals,
    (os.active_referral_limit - os.current_active_referrals) AS available_slots
FROM organizations o
JOIN organization_services os
    ON o.organization_id = os.organization_id
JOIN services s
    ON os.service_id = s.service_id
JOIN service_areas sa
    ON os.service_area_id = sa.area_id
JOIN service_priority_support sps
    ON os.organization_service_id = sps.organization_service_id
JOIN priority_levels pl
    ON sps.priority_id = pl.priority_id
WHERE o.status = 'approved'
  AND os.status = 'active'
  AND sps.is_supported = TRUE
  AND s.service_id = 1
  AND sa.area_id = 1
  AND pl.level_name = 'High'
ORDER BY available_slots DESC

query_name: Question 3 Attendance deadline breaches and responsible referrals: SELECT attendance_records, service_requests, priority_levels, referrals, organizations
source_file: database/queries.sql:83 (Question 3 Attendance deadline breaches and responsible referrals)
sql_statement_or_sqlalchemy_equivalent:
SELECT
    sr.request_id,
    sr.title AS request_title,
    pl.level_name AS priority,
    sr.attendance_deadline,
    ar.first_attended_at,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sr.attendance_deadline, ar.first_attended_at) AS delay_minutes,
    ref.referral_id,
    ref.attempt_number,
    ref.is_backup,
    o.name AS responsible_organization,
    ar.notes AS attendance_notes
FROM attendance_records ar
JOIN service_requests sr
    ON ar.request_id = sr.request_id
JOIN priority_levels pl
    ON sr.priority_id = pl.priority_id
JOIN referrals ref
    ON ar.referral_id = ref.referral_id
JOIN organizations o
    ON ref.organization_id = o.organization_id
WHERE ar.is_on_time = FALSE
   OR ar.first_attended_at > sr.attendance_deadline
ORDER BY delay_minutes DESC

query_name: Question 4 Partner referral acceptance decline and timeout statistics: SELECT organizations, referrals
source_file: database/queries.sql:113 (Question 4 Partner referral acceptance decline and timeout statistics)
sql_statement_or_sqlalchemy_equivalent:
SELECT
    o.organization_id,
    o.name AS organization_name,
    COUNT(r.referral_id) AS total_referrals_sent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('accepted', 'attended', 'completed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'timed_out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timed_out_count,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('accepted', 'attended', 'completed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /
        NULLIF(COUNT(r.referral_id), 0), 1
    ) AS acceptance_rate_percent
FROM organizations o
LEFT JOIN referrals r
    ON o.organization_id = r.organization_id
    AND r.created_at >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY o.organization_id, o.name
ORDER BY total_referrals_sent DESC

query_name: Question 5 Partner on-time attendance rate: SELECT organizations, referrals, attendance_records
sql_statement_or_sqlalchemy_equivalent:

    o.organization_id,
    o.name AS organization_name,
    COUNT(ar.attendance_id) AS total_attended_requests,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_on_time = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_attendances,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_on_time = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_attendances,

        (SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_on_time = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /

JOIN attendance_records ar
    ON r.referral_id = ar.referral_id
GROUP BY o.organization_id, o.name

    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT('Request #', sr.request_id, ' (', o_rescue.name, ')') SEPARATOR '; ') AS rescued_details

query_name: Question 8 Negative feedback by organization and service: SELECT feedback, service_requests, services, organizations
source_file: database/queries.sql:228 (Question 8 Negative feedback by organization and service)
sql_statement_or_sqlalchemy_equivalent:
SELECT
    o.organization_id,
    o.name AS organization_name,
    s.name AS service_name,
    COUNT(f.feedback_id) AS total_feedback_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_helpful = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_helpful_count,
    ROUND(AVG(f.rating), 2) AS average_rating,
    GROUP_CONCAT(f.comment SEPARATOR ' | ') AS member_comments
FROM feedback f

JOIN organizations o
    ON f.organization_id = o.organization_id

GROUP BY o.organization_id, o.name, s.name
HAVING not_helpful_count >= 1

sql_statement_or_sqlalchemy_equivalent:
SELECT sr.request_id,sr.status AS raw_status,sr.created_at,sr.description AS details,
               sr.attendance_deadline,s.name AS service_name,s.delivery_mode,c.name AS category,
               p.level_name AS priority,p.deadline_hours AS priority_hours,
               r.response_deadline,r.status AS referral_status,r.organization_id AS org_id,o.name AS org_name,
               u.email AS contact_email,(u.firebase_uid IS NULL) AS is_guest,
               mp.first_name,mp.last_name,mp.phone AS contact_phone,mp.address AS contact_address,mp.city AS contact_city,
               (sr.attendance_deadline < :now AND a.attendance_id IS NULL
                 AND sr.status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')) AS overdue,
               EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feedback f WHERE f.request_id=sr.request_id AND f.is_helpful=FALSE) AS negative_feedback
        FROM service_requests sr JOIN services s ON s.service_id=sr.service_id
        LEFT JOIN service_categories c ON c.category_id=s.category_id
        JOIN priority_levels p ON p.priority_id=sr.priority_id
        JOIN users u ON u.user_id=sr.member_id LEFT JOIN member_profiles mp ON mp.user_id=u.user_id
        LEFT JOIN referrals r ON r.referral_id=(SELECT latest.referral_id FROM referrals latest
            WHERE latest.request_id=sr.request_id ORDER BY latest.attempt_number DESC LIMIT 1)
        LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.organization_id=r.organization_id
        LEFT JOIN attendance_records a ON a.request_id=sr.request_id
        ORDER BY sr.request_id DESC
